quiz.question: Why can't you measure voltage at a single point?

answers.answer: Because voltage only exists in AC circuits
Because voltage is the difference in electrical pressure between two points
Because voltmeters require at least three connections
Because voltage disappears when you stop the circuit

quiz.explanation: Voltage is always a pressure difference between two points, so you need two reference points to measure it.

quiz.question: A device operates on two AA batteries wired in series. What total voltage do the batteries provide?
quiz.explanation: Each AA battery provides 1.5V. In series, voltages add together: 1.5V + 1.5V = 3V.

quiz.question: Which of the following has the highest voltage?
quiz.explanation: A European wall outlet delivers 230V, which is higher than a car battery (12V), a 9V battery, or a AA battery (1.5V).
